# m.reference.ticker_types

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

The ticker type codes Massive uses, such as `CS` for common stock, with their names.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.reference.ticker_types(*, asset_class=None, locale=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `AssetClass`, `Locale` and `Code`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `asset_class` | The asset class whose types to list. Leave it out for every class. Massive lists no futures types. |
| `locale` | The locale whose types to list. Leave it out for both. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Ticker Types (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Updated as needed |
| Stocks Starter | Updated as needed |
| Stocks Developer | Updated as needed |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated as needed |
| Stocks Business | Updated as needed |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AssetClass` | String | An identifier for a group of similar financial instruments. |
| `Code` | String | A code used by Massive to refer to this ticker type. |
| `Description` | String | A short description of this ticker type. |
| `Locale` | String | An identifier for a geographical location. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
